'use strict';
__ORIGIN__
// __NAME_TEXT__ (__BASE_TEXT__). Generated by tools/source-lab.js (generate) from the VineTheme template of the project: the site is a Next.js
// reader whose pages (the list of titles, a title, a chapter) are React Server Components answers (the page asked with the "rsc" header), which
// this source reads in plain code. Only pages are asked, never the site's /api/ directory. Nothing was copied from another app. What the generator measured on the site is
// in the header of the generated report, not in this file.

const { fetchText } = require('../../server/modules/network/fetch-utils');
const { normalizeStatus } = require('../../server/modules/common/manga-status');
const { proxyImageUrl: proxyImg } = require('../../server/modules/common/image-proxy');
const { rscRows, rscResolve, rscFind } = require('../../server/modules/source-import/rsc-reader');

const BASE = __BASE__;
const SITE = __NAME__;
const GENRE_SLUGS = __GENRE_SLUGS__; // lower-case genre name -> the slug the API's genre filter takes
const PER_PAGE = 24;
const MAX_CHAPTER_PAGES = 40; // the title page lists 100 chapters at a time
// Categories that are never listed. Matched at the start of each word, so a rename or a multi-word name is caught too.
const NEVER_LISTED_RE = /(^|[^a-z])(loli|shota|toddler)/i;
const MANGA_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+$/;
const CHAPTER_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+\/\d{1,6}(?:\.\d{1,3})?$/;
// The sort words the app sends, and what the API takes for each.
const ORDER = { relevance: 'updated', latestUploadedChapter: 'updated', views: 'popular', followedCount: 'trending', rating: 'rating' };
const RSC_HEADERS = { rsc: '1', Accept: 'text/x-component, */*', Referer: `${BASE}/` };

function httpError(message, statusCode) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  e.statusCode = statusCode;
  return e;
}

function empty() {
  return { results: [], hasNextPage: false };
}

// One request where 404 is a normal answer: no retries (guide, section 3).
async function ask(path, headers) {
  let text;
  try {
    text = await fetchText(`${BASE}${path}`, 0, { extraHeaders: headers });
  } catch (err) {
    if (/^HTTP 404$/.test(err.message)) throw httpError('not found', 404);
    throw new Error(`${SITE}: ${err.message}`, { cause: err });
  }
  if (/<title>\s*Just a moment/i.test(text)) throw new Error('the site asked for an anti-bot check (known limit)');
  return text;
}

function absUrl(u = '') {
  const s = String(u).trim();
  if (!s || /^data:/i.test(s)) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
  if (s.startsWith('//')) return `https:${s}`;
  return BASE + (s.startsWith('/') ? s : `/${s}`);
}

function plainText(html) {
  const once = String(html || '').replace(/<(script|style)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, ' ').replace(/<br\s*\/?>|<\/p>|<\/div>/gi, '\n').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ');
  const decoded = once.replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>').replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#0?39;/g, "'");
  return decoded.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n\s*\n+/g, '\n\n').trim();
}

// ---- React Server Components answers --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The page asked with the "rsc" header answers with the data it is made of, as rows (server/modules/source-import/rsc-reader.js, shared with the
// generator so the two read an answer the same way). The data this source wants is found by the names of its fields.

async function rsc(path) {
  const answer = await ask(path, RSC_HEADERS);
  if (/^\s*<(?:!doctype|html)/i.test(answer)) throw new Error(`${SITE}: the site answered with a page, not with the data this source reads`);
  return rscRows(answer);
}

// ---- lists and search ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const genreOf = (g) => (g && typeof g === 'object' ? { name: String(g.name || (g.genre && g.genre.name) || '').trim(), slug: String(g.slug || (g.genre && g.genre.slug) || '').trim() } : { name: String(g || '').trim(), slug: '' });
const genreNames = (item) => (Array.isArray(item && item.genres) ? item.genres.map((g) => genreOf(g).name).filter(Boolean) : []);
const adult = (item) => item && (item.nsfw === true || item.isMature === true);

function card(item) {
  const id = String(item.urlSlug || item.slug || '');
  const cover = absUrl(item.coverImage);
  const genres = genreNames(item);
  return {
    id,
    title: String(item.title || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || id,
    cover: cover ? proxyImg(cover) : '',
    url: `${BASE}/series/comic/${id}`,
    genres: adult(item) && !genres.some((g) => /^adult$/i.test(g)) ? [...genres, 'Adult'] : genres,
    status: normalizeStatus(item.status),
    author: '',
  };
}

// The list of titles is a page of the site: /series?sort=..&page=..&q=..&genre=.. (the site's own search and filters work by these parameters).
async function query({ page = 1, text = '', order = 'relevance', genreSlugs = [] }) {
  const p = Math.max(1, Number(page) || 1);
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ sort: ORDER[order] || ORDER.relevance, page: String(p) });
  if (text) q.set('q', text);
  if (genreSlugs.length) q.set('genre', genreSlugs.join(','));
  const rows = await rsc(`/series?${q}`);
  const paging = rscFind(rows, (o) => 'totalPages' in o && 'hasMore' in o && 'page' in o);
  const found = rscFind(rows, (o) => Array.isArray(o.initialSeries) || typeof o.initialSeries === 'string');
  // A page past the end, or a search with no match, has no list at all: nothing, not an error. Neither list nor paging is a page of another shape.
  if (!paging && !found) throw new Error(`${SITE}: the list has an unexpected shape`);
  const items = found ? rscResolve(found.initialSeries, rows) : [];
  const results = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const item of Array.isArray(items) ? items : []) {
    const id = String((item && (item.urlSlug || item.slug)) || '');
    if (!id || seen.has(id) || !MANGA_ID_RE.test(id) || genreNames(item).some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    results.push(card(item));
  }
  return { results, hasNextPage: !!(paging && paging.hasMore) };
}

module.exports = {
  meta: {
    id: __ID__, name: __NAME__, version: '1.0.0', author: 'generated',
    supportsPopularAllTime: true,
    supportsRecentlyAdded: false,
    ui: {
      filters: {
        orderBy: [
          { value: 'relevance', label: 'Latest Updated' },
          { value: 'views', label: 'Most Viewed' },
          { value: 'followedCount', label: 'Trending' },
          { value: 'rating', label: 'Rating' },
        ],
        publicationStatus: false,
        contentRating: false,
        format: false,
        genres: true,
      },
      genres: __GENRES__,
      nsfwGenres: __NSFW__,
      nativeDates: true,
      adultOnly: __ADULT_ONLY__, // every title of the site is adult: Hide NSFW hides the whole source
    },
  },

  async search(queryText, page = 1, orderBy = '') {
    const q = String(queryText || '').trim();
    if (q && NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(q)) return empty();
    return query({ page, text: q, order: orderBy });
  },

  // The API takes several genre slugs at once: a name the site does not have (or a never-listed one) is nothing.
  async byGenres(genres, orderBy = '', _filters = {}, page = 1) {
    const names = (Array.isArray(genres) ? genres : [genres]).map((g) => String(g || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length || names.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) return empty();
    const slugs = names.map((g) => GENRE_SLUGS[g.toLowerCase()]);
    if (slugs.some((s) => !s)) return empty();
    const list = await query({ page, order: orderBy, genreSlugs: slugs });
    return { results: list.results.map((c) => ({ ...c, genres: c.genres.length ? c.genres : names })), hasNextPage: list.hasNextPage };
  },

  async trending() {
    return { results: (await query({ order: 'followedCount' })).results };
  },

  async latestUpdates() {
    return { results: (await query({ order: 'relevance' })).results };
  },

  async popularAllTime() {
    return { results: (await query({ order: 'views' })).results };
  },

  async mangaDetails(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    const rows = await rsc(`/series/comic/${id}?sort=desc`);
    const found = rscFind(rows, (o) => o.series && typeof o.series === 'object' && o.chapters !== undefined);
    const series = found && rscResolve(found.series, rows);
    if (!series || !series.title) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404); // an answer that is not a title
    const genres = genreNames(series);
    if (genres.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    return {
      id,
      title: String(series.title).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      cover: proxyImg(absUrl(series.coverImage)),
      description: plainText(series.description),
      status: normalizeStatus(series.status),
      genres: adult(series) && !genres.some((g) => /^adult$/i.test(g)) ? [...genres, 'Adult'] : genres,
      author: '',
      url: `${BASE}/series/comic/${id}`,
    };
  },

  async chapters(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    const all = [];
    let totalPages = 1;
    for (let page = 1; page <= Math.min(totalPages, MAX_CHAPTER_PAGES); page += 1) {
      const rows = await rsc(`/series/comic/${id}?sort=desc${page > 1 ? `&page=${page}` : ''}`);
      const found = rscFind(rows, (o) => o.series && typeof o.series === 'object' && o.chapters !== undefined);
      if (!found) { if (page === 1) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404); break; }
      if (page === 1) {
        const series = rscResolve(found.series, rows);
        if (genreNames(series).some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
        totalPages = Number.isInteger(found.totalPages) ? found.totalPages : 1;
      }
      const list = rscResolve(found.chapters, rows);
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) break;
      all.push(...list);
    }
    const now = Date.now();
    const chapters = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const c of all) {
      // A chapter the site keeps back (paid, scheduled) is not a missing chapter and is not offered.
      if (!c || c.isLocked === true || Number(c.coinPrice) > 0 || !Number.isFinite(Number(c.number))) continue;
      const num = String(Number(c.number));
      if (seen.has(num)) continue;
      seen.add(num);
      const title = String(c.title || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      const name = `Chapter ${num}${title && title !== num && title !== `Chapter ${num}` ? ` - ${title}` : ''}`;
      const t = Date.parse(c.publishedAt);
      chapters.push({ id: `${id}/${num}`, name, title: name, chapter: num, url: `${BASE}/series/comic/${id}/chapter/${num}`, publishAt: Number.isFinite(t) && t <= now + 2 * 86400000 ? new Date(t).toISOString() : null, pages: [] });
    }
    if (!chapters.length) throw new Error(`${SITE}: no readable chapter found`);
    chapters.sort((a, b) => Number(b.chapter) - Number(a.chapter)); // newest first
    return { chapters };
  },

  async pages(chapterId) {
    const id = String(chapterId || '');
    if (!CHAPTER_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid chapter id', 400); // also refuses ../../etc/passwd
    const [slug, number] = id.split('/');
    const rows = await rsc(`/series/comic/${slug}/chapter/${number}`);
    const found = rscFind(rows, (o) => o.chapter && typeof o.chapter === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o.chapter) && o.chapter.pages !== undefined);
    const chapter = found && rscResolve(found.chapter, rows);
    if (!chapter) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" not found`, 404);
    const list = (Array.isArray(chapter.pages) ? chapter.pages : []).filter((p) => p && typeof p.imageUrl === 'string' && p.imageUrl.trim());
    // A page the site marks as hidden, encrypted or cut into tiles, strips or fragments is not a picture this source can show as it is.
    if (list.some((p) => p.isRedacted === true || p.isEncrypted === true || (Array.isArray(p.tiles) && p.tiles.length) || p.hasStrips === true || p.hasFragments === true)) {
      throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" is protected by the site (its pages are not plain pictures)`, 403);
    }
    list.sort((a, b) => (Number.isFinite(Number(a.pageNumber)) ? Number(a.pageNumber) : 1e9) - (Number.isFinite(Number(b.pageNumber)) ? Number(b.pageNumber) : 1e9));
    const pages = [];
    for (const p of list) {
      const src = absUrl(p.imageUrl.trim().replace(/ /g, '%20'));
      if (src) pages.push({ index: pages.length, img: proxyImg(src) });
    }
    if (!pages.length) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" not found`, 404); // an answer with no pictures
    return { pages };
  },
};
